subject: Turning off eta adaptation in ADVI

messages.author: 181bcebaf89c73b8
messages.subject: Turning off eta adaptation in ADVI
parts:
Hi all,

Great to have ADVI exposed in rstan again, but I'm unfortunately
getting worse results with the new eta adaptation. Is there a way to
turn this off?

Thanks

David.

--
David A. Knowles,
Stanford University.
E-mail: know...@gmail.com
Web: http://cs.stanford.edu/~davidknowles/

messages.author: 49e107cb0f8a3d27
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Turning off eta adaptation in ADVI
parts:
hi david, there is an `adapt_engaged` argument to vb(), which you can set to `adapt_engaged=FALSE`. I don’t recall if this forces a default parameter for `eta`; if not, you would have to specify it with, say, `eta=0.1`.

Dustin
